preserved_construction_history.result: The frozen Slice 2 harness reached the intentionally missing execution-gateway import after pre-existing governed checks remained green. This was a construction/mechanism absence, not a fixture defect.

15/16 frozen Slice 2 cases passed. S2-02 misclassified a correctly hashed non-authorizing upstream decision as DENIED_UPSTREAM_INTEGRITY instead of DENIED_UPSTREAM. No consequential effect occurred. The fixture and frozen expectation were not changed.

Dedicated Slice 2 construction run passed 16/16 and the full governed construction regression passed 1151/1151, but this pre-freeze green was used only to qualify the candidate for freeze and was not counted as scientific acceptance.

excluded_freeze_evidence.reason: The first freeze record used a placeholder-expanded execution_workflow_commit instead of the authoritative full workflow SHA.
excluded_freeze_evidence.adjudication: Excluded from scientific acceptance regardless of green workflow results. The defect and green-but-ineligible results remain preserved in Git history rather than being silently rewritten or laundered into evidence.

supported_bounded_claims: A clean exact Slice 1 bound decision can cause one local reference execution effect only after fresh use-time revalidation of the frozen authorization and current capability/state bindings.
Non-authorizing upstream states are denied before any effect.
Decision, action, artifact, and request substitution against the upstream binding fail closed before effect.
Fresh capability revocation, expiry, and qualification drift fail closed at use time.
Exact replay returns the original durable result without a duplicate effect.
An idempotency key cannot be rebound to different semantics after its durable binding is established.
A crash before effect commit leaves zero committed effect and an exact retry can execute once.
A crash after effect commit can recover the durable result without duplicating the effect.
Restart preserves exact idempotency and semantic non-rebinding behavior.
Worker output, including terminal-action claims, cannot mint terminal authority.
Release, deploy, merge, and other terminal actions remain behind a separate external authority gate.
Malformed, partial, or conflicting durable gateway state fails closed.
Concurrent identical retries converge on one durable effect/result binding.
Current artifact-binding drift is detected before effect.
Execution evidence retains exact decision, capability, effect, idempotency, and result lineage.
A fresh second authorized request remains live after prior crash/recovery/idempotency history.
claim_boundary: A positive Slice 2 result supports only that, in the tested local reference gateway, an exact externally authorized development effect can be performed at most once under the frozen bindings with replay/restart handling and exact evidence lineage. It does not establish production sandbox security, distributed trust-domain independence, external certification, or terminal/release/deploy authority.
nonclaims: release, deploy, merge, production, or completion authority
retained_hygiene: Historical subprocess ResourceWarnings remain visible in the full governed regression log; they did not fail the frozen run and are not treated as proof of mechanism correctness.
The malformed first freeze and its green workflows remain visible as excluded evidence; green CI is not sufficient when provenance metadata is invalid.
